environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with no additional filtering. Security group allows inbound TCP 80 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service with Python 3.9 and SQLite3. No network-level inspection or application-layer filtering is configured. The ELB performs TCP passthrough on port 80 to the instance port 8080.
